quotations.old_english: Ðá ðæt ðá geseah se ðe hine gebohte, ðæt he mid bendum ne mihte gehaðerod beón
quotations.latin: cumque v&i-short;disset qui em&e-short;rat, vinc&u-short;lis eum non p&o-short;tuisse coh&i-short;b&e-long;ri

source_text: ge-haðerian; p. ode; pp. od To restrain; coh&i-short;b&e-long;re :-- Wambe sár gehaðeraþ it restraineth sore of stomach, Med. ex Quadr. 2, 2; Lchdm. i. 334, 8. Ðá ðæt ðá geseah se ðe hine gebohte, ðæt he mid bendum ne mihte gehaðerod beón cumque v&i-short;disset qui em&e-short;rat, vinc&u-short;lis eum non p&o-short;tuisse coh&i-short;b&e-long;ri, Bd. 4, 22; S. 592, 9. Ic am gehaðrad coarctor, Lk. Skt. Lind. 12, 50. v. ge-heaðerian.
